lastText: ☰⚙File ClosedCommand Without Its CommanderThe Joint Chiefs of Staff, 1940–1945MacArthur never lived to administer this occupation, and Washington vested his authority in Eichelberger instead, following the historical model of near-total personal command right down to the officer's own acknowledgment that history hadn't chosen him for the job.
